description: A polyphonic DC blocker, taking the steady offset out of a signal at a corner frequency you set

params.text: Sets the filter coefficient, 0.9 to 1: the corner drops as the value rises, around 700Hz at 0.9 and around 35Hz at the default 0.995 on a 44.1kHz sample rate, and it moves with the sample rate

inputs.text: The signal to be filtered, all of its channels

outputs.text: The filtered signal, carrying as many channels as the input
